newsitem.title: USA: Kellwood Q4 sales boosted by marketing.
newsitem.headline: Kellwood Q4 sales boosted by marketing.

text.p: Kellwood Co said Thursday marketing programs and operating efficiencies boosted sales in its fourth quarter and fiscal year ended April 30.
Kellwood, an international marketer, merchandiser and manufacturer of apparel, reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.72 a share on sales of $448 million, versus $0.49 a share on $411 million.
Sales growth was posted in each of the its business portfolios, and it is gaining market share, Kellwood said.
Kellwood said operating margins were boosted by shifting sourcing to more competitive world areas, more efficient overhead spending and better capacity utilization.
"Additionally, a number of new and expanding market initiatives contributed to a nine percent boost in sales for the second half," Willian McKenna, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
McKenna said the company made progress on a program to leverage its size and revamp business processes.
"This effort will further enhance our competitive position and enable continued growth in sales and profitability in the future," he said.
